_readme: Optional. Copy to config/pomodoro.json to change the Pomodoro rooms or lengths. match: words looked for in voice channel names (emoji, case and spaces ignored). channelIds: when not empty, exactly these voice channels and no name matching. ambienceKey: the ambience room whose sound plays during a session. Minutes: focus 5 to 90, break 1 to 30, rounds 1 to 8. POMODORO=off in .env turns the feature off.
